scope: Current first-party QCC Nursing Department pages; not a real-time application, exam-registration, seat, program-registration, or licensure determination.
plan_code_verification: Four code-to-plan mappings independently corroborated by the QCC Nursing Department page, not by an NYSED registration database; do not assert independent state registration verification.

exam_evidence.operational_preference: Current Nursing Department and prospective-student instructions both describe NEX, but catalog still conflicts; advise direct confirmation with Nursing Department before purchasing or scheduling.

spring_2027_clinical_application.status_as_of_verification: published application window elapsed as of 2026-10-30; late exceptions, subsequent windows and seat availability not verified

published_exam_price_conflict.guidance: Conflicting QCC figures; check actual NLN checkout and department before payment. Do not display an authoritative current price.

limitations: Four college plan codes are not four federal CIP codes or four distinct licensure categories.
Departmental code corroboration is not NYSED registration-code confirmation.
Published NEX instructions are stronger current operational evidence than an internally contradictory catalog, but do not erase the RN PAX mention.
The October 5–16 application dates concern Spring 2027 clinical Nursing applications, not all college applications or every future nursing intake.
No admissions-policy conclusion about SAT/ACT is inferred from score data.
NCLEX-RN examination eligibility is not an RN license or guarantee of eligibility for an individual.
Do not show fee estimates as a verified current checkout price.
